steps.text: Hello, little chefs! I'm Chef Maya. Let's make warm, soft puffed chapatis!
Wash your hands clean. A grown-up will cook the hot tawa while we help roll the dough!
We need soft whole wheat dough, a pinch of dry flour, and golden warm ghee.
Pinch a smooth round ball of dough and dust it lightly with dry flour.
Roll the rolling pin gently back and forth until the dough becomes a thin circle.
Gently place our flat chapati onto the hot tawa and watch tiny bubbles puff up!
Flip the chapati with our spatula and press softly until it puffs up like a balloon!
Brush with a touch of ghee and serve warm on the plate. Beautiful cooking!
